top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 achievement is mature and independently confirmed, from incretin physiology (Holst) and proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology (Drucker) to long-acting agonists with randomized outcome data (Knudsen). A citation naming both physiology and development describes the full achievement. The Knudsen seat rests on a documented, uncontested contribution, whereas the Mojsov seat depends on a priority question relative to the Habener group that the supplied record cannot resolve. P002 is a clearly acceptable second choice, and any GLP-1 award is preferable to no award.
